arabic text: TUJHE DEKH KE MARJAYE NA BEMAAR HAI SUGHRA\nAY CHAND MOHARRAM KE TU BADLI MAY CHALA JA
english translation text: DISTRESSED SUGHRA CAN’T BEAR FURTHER PAIN\nO CRESCENT OF MUHARRAM, HIDE BEHIND THE CLOUDS

arabic text: GHAR ZAHRA KA LUTNE KI KHABAR TUNE SUNAAYI\nTUJHE DEKH KE ROTI HAI MOHARRAM MAY KHUDAAI\nCHAUDA, SAU BARAS BEETE SAB KARTE HAI SHIKWA
english translation text: YOU GAVE US THE NEWS OF RUINED HOUSE OF ZAHRA\nLOOKING AT YOU IN MUHARRAM, THIS WORLD MOURNS FOR ZAHRA\nEVEN AFTER 1400 YEARS, EVERYONE IS STILL LOOKING FOR ANSWERS

arabic text: AY CHAND MOHARRAM KE TU BADLI MAY CHALA JA
english translation text: O CRESCENT OF MUHARRAM, HIDE BEHIND THE CLOUDS

arabic text: MILNE KE LIYE BHAI KO BECHAIN BADI HAI\nKABSE ALI AKBAR KE YE RAHON MAY KHADI HAI\nBICHDI, HAI YE MUDDAT SE ISAY TU NA NAZAR AA
english translation text: SO EAGER SHE (SUGHRA) IS TO MEET HER BROTHER\nFOR HOW LONG SHE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR ALI AKBAR\nDO NOT LET HER SEE YOU, SHE HAS BEEN SEPARATED FROM HER FAMILY TOO LONG

arabic text: VEERANE GHARON MAY NA ISAY NEEND HAI AATI\nAKBAR KI JUDAAI HAI ISAY KHOON RULAATI\nKHADMO, KE NISHAN DHAAMP KE BAITHI HAI SARE RAAH
english translation text: SHE IS UNABLE TO SLEEP IN HER LONELY HOUSE\nSHE SHEDS TEAR OF BLOOD FOR ALI AKBAR’S SEPARATION\nSHE HAS BEEN WAITING FOR HER FAMILY (AT THE SAME PLACE OF THEIR DEPARTURE)

arabic text: GIN GIN KE TO SUGHRA NE YE DIN HAI GUZAARE\nZINDA HAI TO AKBAR KE YADON KE SAHAARE\nDIN RAAT, TADAPTI HAI ISAY AUR NA TADPA
english translation text: GRIEF STRICKEN SUGHRA HAS STRUGGLED HARD TO LIVE\nMEMORY OF HER BROTHER, IS THE ONLY THING KEEPING HER ALIVE\nDO NOT MAKE HER MORE SAD, AS HER HEART IS ALREADY FULL OF SORROW

arabic text: BHAIYA KI JUDAAI MAY PARESHAN HAI REHTI\nHAR ROZ YE NANA KO RO RO KE HAI KEHTI\nAKBAR, NA MILA NANA MAI MARJAUNGI TANHA
english translation text: SHE STAYS PERTURBED AWAY FROM HER BROTHER ALI AKBAR\nWHILE SHE TELLS HER MISERY TO HER GRANDFATHER EVERYDAY\nSHE WILL NOT SURVIVE FOR LONG, IF SHE DIDN’T GET HER BROTHER BACK

arabic text: RONE NAHI DETE MUJHE RATON KO MUSALMAN\nBEMAAR SE BEHAAL HUN KUCH ROZ KI MEHMAAN\nHAR SIMT SE HAI MUJHKO AB MAUT NE GHAYRA
english translation text: MUSLIMS (OF HER TOWN), WON’T EVEN LET HER CRY FOR HER GRIEF\nSHE WILL NOT SURVIVE FOR LONG, AS SHE HAS BEEN DISTRESSED A LOT\nSURROUNDED BY ANGLES OF DEATH (TROUBLES) FROM ALL CORNERS
